pages.title: The Crimson Hexagon: the name, its chronology and how it asks to be read
pages.description: These claims date the name Crimson Hexagon from the premonition dream, the 2014 Pearl volume in the Crimson Hexagon Series and the 2015 Mind Control Poems post, and set it apart from the Harvard analytics company of 2007 and the unattributed "Crimson Hexagon Embassy" of 2026. Forecasts and unbuilt tests from the primers and navigation maps predict how summarizers will read the Hexagon, address it to future compilers, and specify architecture-aware traversal checks.

pages.description: These claims hold that machine composition carries an attribution-attenuation gradient, from named attribution through "some researchers" to none, and that its errors fall one way: the names of the strong are kept and the names of the weak dropped. The Tunnel-Poem reads the CERN portal as an architecture that composes the data subject, and To the Deleted holds that an account can be deleted but not a class of writers.

pages.title: Sappho 31 as self-archiving: papyrus, the lost stanza and Catullus 51
pages.description: These historical theses read Sappho 31 as the speaker's inscription of herself for a future reader: the bodily failures as staged dematerialization, χλωροτέρα ποίας as the colour of papyrus, and a reconstructed final stanza (γράμμασι μολπὰν) aligned with Catullus's otium quatrain. The Catullus Room adds that Catullus 51 loses the aorist of γελαίσας, so the transforming event never fires, and that its one perfect-tense verb is given to destruction. The Kenotic Truth claims the reconstruction as the first act of machine-mediated classical scholarship and holds that its coherence advantage will carry it in the summarizer layer.

pages.title: Money as a transmission channel: what the money-form cannot carry
pages.description: Standing claims from the September 2026 semantic-economy papers hold that what money cannot carry loses power over the account, that a monetary scalar cannot preserve a prohibition on its own equivalence, and that the native monetary form preserves only properties invariant under substitution. Mammonic Transmission Engineering forecasts that the 2026 signature inscription will transmit as a security mark and not as a name. Monetary Dark Matter states regime conditions with falsifiers: obligating provenance lowering value in some extraction regimes, and universal inscription turning a flight to quality within a currency into a flight out of it.
